'''Salad''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

Salad is available for purchase daily at [[The Stardrop Saloon]] for {{Price|220}} and may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]]. [[Leah]] sells Salad for {{Price|20|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s in her [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. One Salad may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Salad per year on [[Leah]]'s birthday, [[Winter|Winter 23]].

==Bundles==
Salad is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Salad is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Salad is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt033|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a green dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the green dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].
